name: long-audio-parakeet
description: Parakeet TDT v3 INT8 across the duration ladder. Sweeps the pipeline flush threshold from the current UI range (0.5/1/3 s) to null, where null means the hold-scoped push-to-talk behaviour: no mid-recording flush, one decode over the whole buffer. Answers (a) what a single long decode costs in time and RSS, which sets the buffer ceiling, and (b) whether suppressing the flush changes WER.
